title: Reverse Littlewood-Offord at the Carnielli-Carolino threshold

problemStatement.formal: For the Carnielli-Carolino configuration z_0=1 and z_i=i in even dimension n>=2, prove every sign vector has signedSumAbs at least sqrt 2, then connect this witness to the reverse Littlewood-Offord threshold and the 1/n optimal-constant framework.
problemStatement.plain: Backfill the reverse Littlewood-Offord metadata around the Lean results: the axiom-free parity proof of the Carnielli-Carolino lower bound, the derived failure of the original threshold-1 question, and the remaining optimal-constant facts that still depend on external probability estimates.
whyMatters: The file turns the geometric counterexample into explicit Lean arithmetic on sign vectors.
It separates the elementary parity proof from deeper HJNS and extremal-distribution inputs.
The metadata should make clear that the exact optimal constant remains open even though the threshold obstruction is formalized.

proven: `counterexample_always_large_proved` proves the Carnielli-Carolino sqrt 2 lower bound without axioms in `Erdos395OQ01Incomplete01.lean`.
`valid_constants_nonempty`, `valid_constants_bddAbove`, and `optimal_constant_pos` build the positive optimal-constant framework in `Erdos395OQ01.lean`.
`counterexample_exceeds_one`, `erdos_original_is_false_proved`, and `sqrt2_is_critical` record the threshold-1 obstruction and the critical sqrt 2 boundary.
`count_monotone_threshold`, `rate_is_tight`, `extremal_is_unit`, and `optimal_constant_summary` document monotonicity, tightness, and the final rate summary.
open: `counterexample_always_large` and `extremal_example_tight` are axioms in `Erdos395OQ01.lean`; the companion incomplete file proves the first one for the Carnielli-Carolino configuration.
`hjns_2024` remains the imported deep reverse Littlewood-Offord input; the exact optimal constant is not determined here.
The active Lean files have zero sorries.
knownResults.goal: Clarify the verified counterexample proof and the axiom boundary for the optimal reverse Littlewood-Offord constant.
